tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere: the warm cream ground.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the renter’s pages: one step up from the page.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table headers, selected rows, grouped info, the next-step panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and icons on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, helper copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, radios and secondary buttons (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons: the one main action on a screen.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand blocks: the workspace sidebar, hero bands, large panels. Text on it uses nav-ink.

tokens.name: atlantic
tokens.usage: The accent: one emphasis per screen (the wordmark full stop, a key number). Fills and large type.

tokens.name: atlantic-text
tokens.usage: Atlantic for small text, links and the focus ring.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Soft brand fill: selected rows, brand blocks, illustration. Text on it is ink, never atlantic-text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, verified, passed: check results, signed, paid. Text and icons.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for success pills and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, including a renter who did not meet a check. Text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for warning pills and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Something went wrong (a send failed) or a destructive action. Never for a renter who failed a check.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for danger pills and notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and viewings booked. Teal, so it never reads as the brand blue.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for info pills and notices.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Anything the AI wrote or suggested (“Drafted by AI”). Same as info today; its own name so it can change later.

tokens.name: ai-bg
tokens.usage: Background for the AI label and the AI draft card header.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Workspace sidebar and the mobile bottom bar.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Active item and labels on nav-bg and navy.

tokens.name: nav-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive items and counts on nav-bg.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Background of the active nav item.

tokens.name: nav-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the navy sidebar and bottom bar, where focus would be too faint (2.2:1).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile menu.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Letting a home should be quick

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: the letting’s address, the renter’s home.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.usage: Page titles at phone width (390px), on renter pages and the workspace.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and big numbers (days to let, time saved).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Thanks for your interest. We’ll be in touch by Friday either way.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller on renter pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense workspace tables and secondary lines. Workspace only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and table headers. Status pills use its size and weight, in sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes and fine print. Never for anything a renter must read or act on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; the side gutter on renter pages.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row insets in workspace lists.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page header and content on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, list rows, viewing slots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts only. Everything else uses borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus, small colour changes.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Expanding rows, tabs, fades.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and the mobile menu.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most movement.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving on screen.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving the screen.

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, motion-fast, motion-base and motion-slow are 0ms.

rules.large: Large text (24px+, or 19px bold) and fills: 3:1 or more
rules.ui: Edges, focus rings and controls: 3:1 or more
